H1.text: Most news publishers (>50%) still do NOT block meta-externalagent days before 30 Oct.

H2.text: Few publishers (<5%) changed their Meta rules after 15 Oct.

H3.text: meta-externalads is blocked far less often than meta-externalagent (the ads gap).

H4.text: Publishers block OpenAI/Anthropic/Google training bots more often than Meta's (the Meta gap).

H5.text: A large share (>50%) of Meta-linked publishers are exposed.

H6.text: Changes cluster by owner group or platform template (chain-level decisions).
